description:
Two songs from Figmore's debut album, 'Jumbo Street' – out now: freshselects.bandcamp.com/album/jumbo-street


Figmore is a duo consisting of Westchester, NY singer/musician JUICEB☮X and Renton, WA producer/musician, 10.4 Rog – now joining forces in Los Angeles to forge their own blend of indie psych R&B +

Vocals, Trumpet, & Tambourine by JUICEB☮X
Produced & Mixed by 10.4 Rog

Mastered by Kelly Hibbert at Almachrome

Artwork by Tawfiq Mardini

Executive Producers: Figmore & Kenny / Fresh Selects
Co-Executive Producers: Warsame Warsame & J. Pinder for PLZCOMEAGAIN

FSX-047-01 © 2021 Fresh Selects.
